class: Any live-data freshness rule that compares a feed timestamp against a 'now' read at the START of a request, before slow reads (broker margin, positions) that run while the feed keeps ticking, refuses every tick newer than that 'now' (a rule of 0 <= now - t fails for t after now), so a healthy, fast feed reads as out of date exactly when the data is freshest. Replay tests cannot see it when their clock is pinned after the recorded frame.
mechanism: The Execute gate judged live-quote freshness against req.now, read at request start, then fetched Zerodha margin and positions; NIFTY 50 ticks every second, so the newest tick was always later than req.now and the 0 <= now - t rule refused it with MARKET_DATA_103 ('underlying price is out of date').

first_seen.where: GC-3L live entry attempts on ofo_dev with the owner's Kite account, strategy 11
first_seen.evidence: 5 prepares on strategy 11 logged `pre-execution blocked ... codes=DATA_UNHEALTHY` while the outcome socket showed spot_at <= 1 s old each second (spot 23131.85-23135.9); every live ENTRY refused with MARKET_DATA_103; replay tests passed because their clock is pinned after the recorded frame

fix: Freshness is judged on checked_at = req.clock() read AFTER the quotes arrive, with a window of -2 s skew to 60 s. PR #427.

detection.note: PR #427 tests the gate with a clock that advances while the slow reads run. Not covered: other routes that read a request clock before slow calls; a pinned-clock replay test still cannot see this class by itself.

occurrences.evidence: 5 prepares blocked with DATA_UNHEALTHY / MARKET_DATA_103 while spot_at <= 1 s old
